scope: Headless actual 20-animal manifest and actual town navigation; graph validity and runtime state audit. Static mesh collisions need geometry replay and renderer/animation QA remains outside this audit.

findings.title: Human interaction endpoint can be permanently occupied by target animal
findings.cause: startApproach snaps fixed human and dog offsets to adjacent 0.5m grid points. Their actual radius sum plus stop margin is .58298m, so human goal only .5m away from the dog is dynamically unreachable. updateHuman has no approach timeout or valid standoff completion fallback.
findings.suggestion: Choose human/animal endpoints jointly with real radii and available legal cells. Replan occupied goals; allow completion at validated standoff rather than waiting forever for exact grid goal.

findings.title: Animals can pass through stationary human
findings.cause: move hard collision predicate o.air<=.4 excludes the human because human.air is undefined. Steering repulsion alone permits deep overlap.
findings.suggestion: Normalize air to zero for all ground agents or use (o.air||0)<=.4 in every separation predicate.

findings.title: Airborne social initiation can restart old flight path and teleport bird
findings.cause: fly() selects its path from perchIndex while a bird can be midway through an existing flight. updatePairs calls fly unconditionally in bird-start, so current position jumps to an old perch-based route.
findings.suggestion: Reserve or defer bird interaction until existing flight reaches a perch; preserve current path position when requesting another flight.

findings.title: Resting outdoors is incorrectly accepted as weather shelter
findings.cause: shelter() only creates a shelter path when state is neither shelter nor rest. An animal resting in the open remains in place throughout storm/night.
findings.suggestion: Track shelter arrival or proximity separately from rest action; weather must route outdoor resting animals to an actual sheltered slot.

findings.title: Bird feeding completes without bird reaching feeding station
findings.cause: startApproach sets a ground path on an airborne bird, but update skips ground movement when air>.1. A later fly() clears its path, satisfying feed path-empty condition even though no food arrival occurred.
findings.suggestion: Define an elevated bird feeder destination and flight approach, or suppress unsupported bird feed until contact is implemented. Test physical proximity and appropriate action before completion.

findings.title: Actual asset radii exceed sampled habitat clearance
findings.cause: Navigation was sampled before final animal dimensions. Pony radius .79466 exceeds .6 clearance; golden .44715 exceeds .42. This is a coverage gap, not proof of a current mesh intersection.
findings.suggestion: Resample local habitat and edge geometry with final asset radius or validate its actual oriented footprint along every permitted route.
